title: Explosive Cubes
description: Sulfur Cubes now go kaboom with TNT.
body:
## Explosive Cubes

This mod extends the functionality of the new Sulfur Cubes to make them carry TNT and explode on heavy impact.

![tnt-sulfur-cubes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/5wBueqhU/images/75663a03db5fb644448aef2b3022f3cfc6441dd2.png)

### Features

- Sulfur Cubes can hold TNT.
- Explodes on heavy impact (based on impact angle and Cube speed).
- Explosive power inspired by the TNT Minecarts.

### Planned

- NeoForge version.
- Configuration options:
  - Base explosive power (minimum power the explosion will have).
  - Speed explosive factor (how impactful speed is to the explosive power).
  - Required speed (minimum amount of speed to explode the TNT).
- Instantly explode when hit with flame arrows.
